Given the history here I'd rather not go through the usual queue again. Can whoever picked up the last case take this one too?

tickets.subject: Report builder issue — following up after our call
tickets.body: Thanks for the call last week and for walking through the root cause on the export and dashboard problems — genuinely helpful to finally understand what was happening underneath. Small thing on top: a report template started throwing an error this morning, probably unrelated. Could you take a look when you get a chance?

tickets.subject: Seat billing correction — thank you
tickets.body: Confirming the seat billing credit came through as discussed on the call. Appreciate the account review — it's the first time someone actually walked us through the whole seat history instead of just closing individual tickets. One follow-up: can you add my colleague Mira as a co-admin so this doesn't all sit with one person?

tickets.subject: Connector question — nothing urgent
tickets.body: Quick one, not a complaint this time — our new connector to the payroll system needs a field mapping adjustment. No rush, whenever it fits your queue.

tickets.subject: Connector sync failing intermittently
tickets.body: Our warehouse connector has failed to sync three times this week, no pattern I can find. Logs on our side show nothing wrong. Can you check from your end?

tickets.subject: Dashboards broken since the connector fix
tickets.body: Since the connector patch last week, two of our dashboards are showing stale or missing data. Feels like the fix broke something downstream. Eight days is a long time for something that used to just work.

tickets.subject: Alerts not firing — third issue in six weeks
tickets.body: Now our alerts have stopped triggering entirely, on top of the connector and dashboard problems from last month. This account has had a broken component every few weeks since March and nobody seems able to tell me why. Fifteen days to fix an alert is not acceptable.

tickets.subject: API errors — fed up
tickets.body: API calls failing intermittently since yesterday. Given everything else this spring, I'm not holding my breath this gets looked at quickly.

tickets.subject: Escalating — this account needs a proper review
tickets.body: Between connectors, dashboards, alerts and now the API ticket still sitting open, I'd like someone to actually review this account rather than close tickets one at a time. Report builder is now throwing errors too. Please escalate to whoever can look at the whole picture.

tickets.subject: Connector issue back again — escalating again
tickets.body: The connector problem from March is back. I asked for this to be properly reviewed in May and it's happened again anyway. I don't want another quick patch, I want to know what's actually different this time before I trust it again.

tickets.subject: Re: connector escalation — thanks for the call
tickets.body: Appreciate the engineer getting on a call yesterday and actually showing us the sync logs — first time anyone's explained what was failing and why. Dashboards are looking correct again this morning. Will keep an eye on it.

tickets.subject: Connector holding up so far
tickets.body: One week in and the connector's been stable, no dropped syncs. Small follow-up — could we get an email notification if a sync fails, rather than finding out from a stale dashboard?

tickets.subject: Notification setting for connector — following up
tickets.body: Checking in on the sync failure notification I asked about a couple weeks ago. No rush, just don't want it to fall off the list.

tickets.subject: Adding a seat for new data analyst
tickets.body: We're growing the team — need to add one more seat. Straightforward one this time, hopefully!

tickets.subject: Minor connector field mapping
tickets.body: Small mapping fix needed on the inventory connector — one field renamed on our source system. Should be quick.
